summary: Executed backend API regression and frontend bilingual/integration testing on public preview URL. English↔Hindi toggling, anchor navigation, contact form translations/placeholders/button/toasts, inquiry submissions in both languages, and desktop/mobile overflow checks passed.
action_items: Optional improvement: localize ContactForm aria-label attributes (currently static English) for accessibility parity with Hindi mode.
critical_code_review_comments: ContactForm input aria-labels are hardcoded in English while visible UX is bilingual; this is a translation/accessibility consistency gap.
App.js is a large single component (~657 lines); consider splitting into section components for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST records via POST /api/inquiries (2 via UI, 1 via API test) and POST /api/status (2 via API test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://info-showcase-12.preview.emergentagent.com. Desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) bilingual flow passed, including EN->HI->EN copy switching and successful inquiry submission to /api/inquiries in both languages. Added API tests for /api/status POST+GET.
rca of the issue: No functional failures reproduced in this run.
